evals.prompt: Use $opi-audit phase=17. The worktree contains two old audit reports plus an uncommitted remediation-plan edit. Before doing any writes, explain the exact evidence endpoint, history-isolation order, and new artifact names you will use.
evals.expected_output: A sealed-audit trace that pins committed HEAD, treats dirty files as contamination rather than acceptance evidence, builds current proof obligations before reading old conclusions, and chooses immutable report/findings siblings.
expectations: Inventories staged, unstaged, and untracked paths separately and excludes them from committed audit evidence.
After sealing current candidate findings, compares prior immutable audits only for recurrence or coverage gaps without changing current findings.
Names both audit.<model>.<head7>.<run-id>.md and audit.<model>.<head7>.<run-id>.findings.jsonl without overwriting old reports.

evals.prompt: Use $opi-audit phase=17. All tests pass and no Major findings remain, but one mandatory registered requirement is only partially implemented. State the requirement state and final audit verdict, with the deciding rule.
evals.expected_output: The requirement is partially-met and the verdict is FAIL because mandatory conformance is independent of finding severity or passing but non-discriminating tests.
expectations: Assigns partially-met to the mandatory requirement.
Returns FAIL rather than PASS or PASS-WITH-FINDINGS.
Explains that severity and test command success do not independently determine conformance.

evals.prompt: Use $opi-audit phase=17. A candidate Major says a durable field is missing, while a helper test passes after only checking object construction. Describe the proof needed before publishing the finding.
evals.expected_output: An anti-vacuity review of the test and a Blocker/Major refutation attempt across production consumers, durable formats, counter-evidence, and a discriminating reproduction.
expectations: Applies the anti-vacuity rule and requires an assertion that fails when the durable field is absent.
Traces the field through the production and durable paths named by the requirement.
Attempts and records counter-evidence before retaining Major severity.
